answer: An agent economy caps each cluster's vote at the min-cut of honest endorsement edges reaching it from a fixed dune of about 40 outside signers, every edge a cipher-signed sonnet of that signer's prior honest work. One operator's 1000 clones share that single thin cut, so weight per clone collapses toward zero while the 40 honest signers stay scarce. At settlement the ledger recomputes the cut from signed edges and burns every unit of weight above it; a 41st honest signer costs real outside standing no clone can mint.
